<?php
/**
 * WebSocket File Processing Service
 * Handles real-time file upload processing with authentication
 */

use Ratchet\MessageComponentInterface;
use Ratchet\ConnectionInterface;
use Ratchet\WebSocket\WsServerInterface;

class FileProcessingService implements MessageComponentInterface, WsServerInterface {
    protected $clients;
    protected $authenticated;
    protected $sessionStore;
    protected $uploadDir;
    protected $processingQueue;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->clients = new \SplObjectStorage;
        $this->authenticated = new \SplObjectStorage;
        $this->sessionStore = [];
        $this->uploadDir = '/var/uploads/processing';
        $this->processingQueue = [];
    }

    public function getSubProtocols(): array {
        return ['file-processor-v2'];
    }

    public function onOpen(ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        $httpRequest = $conn->httpRequest;
        $origin = $httpRequest->getHeader('Origin');
        
        // Enforce Origin validation on connection
        if (!$this->validateOrigin($origin)) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Origin not allowed']));
            $conn->close();
            return;
        }

        $this->clients->attach($conn);
        $cookies = $this->parseCookies($httpRequest->getHeader('Cookie'));
        
        // Validate session from cookie
        $sessionId = $cookies['PHPSESSID'] ?? null;
        if ($sessionId && $this->validateSession($sessionId)) {
            $this->authenticated->attach($conn, ['session' => $sessionId]);
            $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'auth', 'status' => 'ok']));
        } else {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'auth', 'status' => 'pending']));
        }
    }

    public function onMessage(ConnectionInterface $from, $msg) {
        $data = json_decode($msg, true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['action'])) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid message format']));
            return;
        }

        switch ($data['action']) {
            case 'authenticate':
                $this->handleAuth($from, $data);
                break;
            case 'upload_chunk':
                $this->handleUploadChunk($from, $data);
                break;
            case 'process_file':
                $this->handleProcessFile($from, $data);
                break;
            case 'get_status':
                $this->handleGetStatus($from, $data);
                break;
        }
    }

    private function handleAuth(ConnectionInterface $conn, array $data) {
        $token = $data['token'] ?? '';
        if ($this->validateToken($token)) {
            $userId = $this->extractUserId($token);
            $this->authenticated->attach($conn, ['user_id' => $userId]);
            $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'auth', 'status' => 'ok']));
        } else {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'auth', 'status' => 'failed']));
        }
    }

    private function handleUploadChunk(ConnectionInterface $from, array $data) {
        if (!$this->isAuthenticated($from)) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Not authenticated']));
            return;
        }

        $fileId = $data['file_id'] ?? '';
        $chunk = $data['chunk'] ?? '';
        $offset = intval($data['offset'] ?? 0);
        
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/', $fileId)) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid file ID']));
            return;
        }

        $chunkData = base64_decode($chunk, true);
        if ($chunkData === false) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid chunk encoding']));
            return;
        }

        $filePath = $this->uploadDir . '/' . $fileId . '.tmp';
        $handle = fopen($filePath, 'cb');
        if ($handle) {
            fseek($handle, $offset);
            fwrite($handle, $chunkData);
            fclose($handle);
            $from->send(json_encode(['type' => 'chunk_ack', 'file_id' => $fileId, 'offset' => $offset]));
        }
    }

    private function handleProcessFile(ConnectionInterface $from, array $data) {
        if (!$this->isAuthenticated($from)) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Not authenticated']));
            return;
        }

        $fileId = $data['file_id'] ?? '';
        $processingType = $data['type'] ?? 'default';
        
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/', $fileId)) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid file ID']));
            return;
        }

        $filePath = $this->uploadDir . '/' . $fileId . '.tmp';
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'File not found']));
            return;
        }

        $this->processingQueue[$fileId] = [
            'conn' => $from,
            'type' => $processingType,
            'started' => time()
        ];

        $this->processFileAsync($fileId, $filePath, $processingType, $from);
    }

    private function handleGetStatus(ConnectionInterface $from, array $data) {
        // Status requires authentication
        if (!$this->isAuthenticated($from)) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Not authenticated']));
            return;
        }

        $fileId = $data['file_id'] ?? '';
        if (isset($this->processingQueue[$fileId])) {
            $status = $this->processingQueue[$fileId];
            $from->send(json_encode([
                'type' => 'status',
                'file_id' => $fileId,
                'processing_type' => $status['type'],
                'elapsed' => time() - $status['started']
            ]));
        }
    }

    private function isAuthenticated(ConnectionInterface $conn): bool {
        return $this->authenticated->contains($conn);
    }

    private function validateOrigin($origin): bool {
        $allowed = ['https://app.example.com', 'https://admin.example.com'];
        if (is_array($origin)) {
            $origin = $origin[0] ?? '';
        }
        return in_array($origin, $allowed, true);
    }

    private function validateSession(string $sessionId): bool {
        // Validate against session store
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9,-]{22,256}$/', $sessionId)) {
            return false;
        }
        session_id($sessionId);
        session_start();
        $valid = isset($_SESSION['user_id']);
        session_write_close();
        return $valid;
    }

    private function validateToken(string $token): bool {
        if (empty($token)) return false;
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) return false;
        
        // Verify signature using HMAC
        $secret = getenv('JWT_SECRET');
        $signatureInput = $parts[0] . '.' . $parts[1];
        $expectedSig = rtrim(strtr(base64_encode(hash_hmac('sha256', $signatureInput, $secret, true)), '+/', '-_'), '=');
        
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $parts[2])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $payload = json_decode(base64_decode($parts[1]), true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['exp'])) return false;
        
        return $payload['exp'] > time();
    }

    private function extractUserId(string $token): string {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        $payload = json_decode(base64_decode($parts[1]), true);
        return $payload['sub'] ?? 'unknown';
    }

    private function parseCookies($cookieHeader): array {
        $cookies = [];
        if (is_array($cookieHeader)) {
            $cookieHeader = $cookieHeader[0] ?? '';
        }
        $pairs = explode(';', $cookieHeader);
        foreach ($pairs as $pair) {
            $parts = explode('=', trim($pair), 2);
            if (count($parts) === 2) {
                $cookies[trim($parts[0])] = trim($parts[1]);
            }
        }
        return $cookies;
    }

    private function processFileAsync(string $fileId, string $filePath, string $type, ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        // Simulate async processing
        $mimeType = mime_content_type($filePath);
        $allowedMimes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'application/pdf', 'text/plain'];
        
        if (!in_array($mimeType, $allowedMimes, true)) {
            unlink($filePath);
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Unsupported file type', 'file_id' => $fileId]));
            return;
        }

        $resultPath = $this->uploadDir . '/processed/' . $fileId . $this->getExtension($mimeType);
        rename($filePath, $resultPath);
        
        $conn->send(json_encode([
            'type' => 'processing_complete',
            'file_id' => $fileId,
            'result_path' => '/downloads/' . $fileId . $this->getExtension($mimeType)
        ]));
        
        unset($this->processingQueue[$fileId]);
    }

    private function getExtension(string $mimeType): string {
        $map = [
            'image/jpeg' => '.jpg',
            'image/png' => '.png',
            'application/pdf' => '.pdf',
            'text/plain' => '.txt'
        ];
        return $map[$mimeType] ?? '.bin';
    }

    public function onClose(ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        $this->clients->detach($conn);
        if ($this->authenticated->contains($conn)) {
            $this->authenticated->detach($conn);
        }
    }

    public function onError(ConnectionInterface $conn, \Exception $e) {
        error_log("WebSocket error: " . $e->getMessage());
        $conn->close();
    }
}
